contents.text: فحللته سريعا وارسلته وهو
نديمي قم فاسقني بكاس كبير هني / ودع كاسنا اطلسا ولا تسقني معدن [last words of both verses doubtful; verse 2 ending possibly 'مع دني']

ثم كتبت له بيتين قد من عقدين فيهما جناس غيرت / منهما حللت فقتل لصب وهو محرم وكتبته / حللت فقتلي وهو غير محلل لما فيه من الالف واللام ليصعب حله [lines 4-6 partly doubtful, esp. 'قد من عقدين' and 'فقتل']

contents.direction_remark: not stated; dotted-vertical dividers, 3-5 groups per line (approx 3,4,5,4,4,4 groups); contains some rectangular/box-shaped signs on line 5; counts approximate

contents.text: فحللهما سريعا وارسلهما وهما

technique_remarks: وهو غير محلل لما فيه من الالف واللام ليصعب حله - 'it is unsolvable/unsolved because it contains alif and lam (kept apart), so that its solution is harder'; also 'بيتين فيهما جناس' - two verses containing paronomasia (jinas)
plaintext_for: top of page (lines 1-3, verses) answers a cipher block on the previous page (f. 54v, presumed, not checked); the new block on this page (lines 7-12, two verses) is followed by 'fa-halaltuhuma ... wa-huma' on line 13, plaintext expected on f. 55v
certainty: medium for layout and counts, low-medium for individual Arabic words; worm hole and stain at left/top margins

contents.text: فعلام تعتمدين قتل متيم افما هناك يا سعاد دناك [?] / حللت قتلي وهو غير محلل فبطرفك الفتاك من افتاك [two verses with rhyme -ak; many words doubtful, esp. line 1 end and line 2 middle]
ثم كتبت له بيتين قد من غيرت منهما الفاظا بحيث لا تكرر / اداة التعريف وعقدتهما عليه ليصعب حلهما ومما [text continues into the cipher; 'من' in 'قد من' doubtful]

contents.direction_remark: not stated; this block uses a distinct alphabet of numeral-like signs (5-, 4-, 3-, 2-shapes, m-shaped and hook signs) with dotted dividers; groups of 3-6 signs, about 4-5 groups per line (counts approximate; no red letters found in the text area by colour check of the image)

contents.text: فحل ذلك سريعا وارسله وهو
شهود ودي نوري ومن صادقه وحاكم القلب يدري / كابه حكما [one verse begun on lines 12-13, second hemistich/verse not on this page; words doubtful]

technique_remarks: بحيث لا تكرر اداة التعريف - 'so that the definite article (al-) is not repeated' / وعقدتهما عليه ليصعب حلهما - 'I knotted/encoded them on it so that solving them is harder' (the two verses of f. 55r lines 7-12 or the new pair)
plaintext_for: lines 1-2 give the plaintext of the block on f. 55r (lines 7-12, 'fa-halaltuhuma ... wa-huma'); lines 3-4 introduce the new block on this page (lines 5-10); line 11 'fa-halla dhalika sari'an wa-arsalahu wa-huwa' and lines 12-13 are the start of the plaintext for this block (verse continues on f. 56r, not seen)
certainty: medium for layout, low-medium for individual Arabic words; large worm hole at left of line 2; page has stain at right

contents.text: هب انني مدع قد غاب شاهده اما ضميرك يقضي في سما علما [second verse/hemistich of the plaintext begun on f. 55v lines 12-13; rhyme -ma matches 'hukman' there; several words doubtful]
ثم كتبت له بيتين من ابيات لابن فرح الاشبيلي وزكن [?] / فيها بعلم الحديث اشفيتهما وهما [line 2 end 'wa-zkn' unclear; line 3 'ishfaytuhuma'/'ashfaytuhuma' doubtful]

contents.direction_remark: not stated; numeral-like signs again (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8 shapes, 'H' and 'm' shapes) with a repeated sequence '1 4 8' (vertical stroke + 4 + 8) recurring on lines 6-8; dotted dividers, about 4-5 groups per line; sign counts approximate

contents.text: فحل ذلك سريعا وارسله وهو
ولاحسن الاسماع حديثكم مشافهة يملى علي فانقل / وامري موقوف عليك وليس لي على احد الا عليك معول [two verses, hadith vocabulary (mushafaha, yumla, mawquf, ma'wal); doubtful words in line 10]
ثم انقطعت عن ما بر [?] العالي مدة فكتب لي يعاتبني على ذلك [word after 'an' unclear, possibly 'ma'thir' (deeds) or a name/title al-'Ali]

contents.direction_remark: first line of a new block; continues on f. 56v (next page); line mixes letter-like and numeral-like signs; dividers about 4-5; count approximate

correspondents.note: poet cited as the source of two verses with hadith-science vocabulary (not a 'wa-kataba li' formula); reading of the name moderately secure. A second, unnamed correspondent ('al-'Ali', reading doubtful) writes to chide the compiler for a pause in correspondence (line 12) - the new block on line 13 is his letter

technique_remarks: ثم كتبت له بيتين من ابيات لابن فرح ... فيها بعلم الحديث - 'then I wrote him two verses from verses of Ibn Farh al-Ishbili ... containing the science of hadith'; ولاحسن الاسماع [...] - plaintext uses hadith terminology (mawquf, musafaha); no further technique statement on this page
plaintext_for: line 1 completes the plaintext of the block on f. 55v lines 5-10; lines 10-11 are the plaintext for the block on this page (lines 4-8); block at line 13 continues on f. 56v, plaintext not seen yet
certainty: medium for layout, low-medium for words in lines 2-3 and 12; worm holes at left margin lines 9-10, left stains

contents.direction_remark: continuation of the one-line block begun at f. 56r line 13 (so the block is about 49 signs in 3 lines); letter-like signs (hooks, triangles, 'sin'-like cups, a repeated double-box sign) with dotted dividers; 4-5 groups per line; counts approximate

contents.text: فحللته سريعا والحمد لله في الحال سهله الله تعالى مع قلته / لكن لما اخل بعضه اخل جميعه لشهرته وهو [words doubtful: 'لشهرته']
ارض لمن غاب عنك غيبته فذاك ذنب عفا به فيه [verse, last words doubtful]
فكتبته وكتبت تحته هذا المترجم وارسلته الى بين يديه الشريفتين وهو جوابه لكنه من نظمي وكنت صدرت به [last word(s) of line 7 doubtful; 'al-mutarjam' = the interpreted/translated cipher]

contents.direction_remark: not stated; same family of signs as the first block (triangle, V, hook and cup signs plus a few numeral-like 4/7/8 shapes); groups of 1-6 signs, about 4-5 groups per line; short last line; counts approximate

contents.text: فحله مع قلته وغرابته وليس فيه سوى الفين وارسله وهو
نديمك في كل وقت جذل ومستنصر بك ما ان خذل [verse; 'ما ان خذل' doubtful]
الجذل الفرح والجذلان مثل فرحان وكتبت اليه

correspondents.translit: the addressee of 'wa-arsaltuhu ila bayna yadayhi al-sharifatayn' (sent to his noble hands)
correspondents.note: no name given on this page; the person who wrote the block at 56r line 13 appears to have been answered by the compiler's verse in line 5

technique_remarks: فحللته ... مع قلته - 'I solved it with its shortness'; لما اخل بعضه اخل جميعه - 'since part of it was faulty, all of it was' (sentence cut); وكتبت تحته هذا المترجم - 'and I wrote under it this interpretation (al-mutarjam)'; مع قلته وغرابته وليس فيه سوى الفين - 'despite its brevity and rarity/oddness, and there is nothing in it but two alifs (or: only two lines?)'; line 13 glosses jadhil (joy) and jadhlan like farhan (lexical comment on the plaintext)
plaintext_for: lines 1-2 are the continuation of the cipher begun on f. 56r line 13; its plaintext is the verse on line 5 (with the prose lines 3-4 and 6-7); block lines 8-10 is answered by the verse on line 12 (after 'fa-halla ... wa-arsalahu wa-huwa')
certainty: medium for layout and sign counts, low-medium for words in lines 4-7 and 11; worm hole at left of line 1-2

contents.text: اتى على الله شانه وقد نويت من امرا لم يكن [doubtful; text just before the cipher; continues 'wa-kataba ilayhi' from f. 56v line 13]

contents.direction_remark: not stated; letter-like signs with a recurring sequence resembling lam-lam-ha (the shape 'للـه') in each line, plus K-shaped, m-shaped and box ('I'-shaped) signs; 3 dividers per line; signs are larger and more spaced than on 56v; counts approximate

contents.text: فحله ونبه على انني غلطت وجعلت الشين صيغتين / ونبه على انه فهم قصدك بقوله فبصدق وان كان فيه / مني بعض اساءة ادب ولكن ما يفهمها كل احد فكتبته / حاشاك ان يثنيك عني كاشح فبصدق وعدك بطمين / جميرت [lines 8-9 look like a verse, words doubtful; line 9 is a one-word tail]

ثم كتب بعد تنبيهه على السهو في الشين والفاء ينبغي ان / تكون واوا فان قصد نعيين فهو سهل والا فهو سهو اخر / فقوله واو اريد واو الاضمار فسبحان من اعطاه هذا الذهن / العظيم الذي والله قل من في هذا العصر ان يفهم مقصدك [several words doubtful, esp. 'نعيين', 'الاضمار']

technique_remarks: وجعلت الشين صيغتين - 'and I made the shin two forms (two shapes for shin)'; ثم كتب بعد تنبيهه على السهو في الشين والفاء ينبغي ان تكون واوا - 'then he wrote, after pointing out the slip with shin and fa (the fa) ought to have been waw'; واو الاضمار - 'waw of the pronoun/ellipsis'; فسبحان من اعطاه هذا الذهن العظيم - praise of the solver's intelligence, 'few in this age understand your intent'. The solver (correspondent) reports the compiler's errors: shin given two shapes, a fa that should be waw
plaintext_for: block on this page (lines 2-4): the compiler says it was solved ('fa-halla-hu') and that the sender erred; the plaintext of the block itself is NOT given on this page (lines 8-9 may be a verse reply, not the solution); check f. 57v
certainty: medium for layout, low-medium for words in lines 1 and 8-13; worm hole at right margin line 2

contents.text: في الفاء اذا سمع هذا وما احسن جناس قوله فهو سهل / والا فهو سهو ثم كتبت له عظم الله شانه بيتين من قصيده / في انشفيتهما [line 3 short and doubtful; continues the discussion of the fa/waw slip from f. 57r]

contents.gloss_letters: L4 (right to left): ع ل ي و ج ه ه م ا ا ل ج م | L5: ا ل م ر ق ر ق ي ز ي د ا ذ ا | L6: ر د د ت ط ر ف ك ر ن ق ا | L7: ث ب د ي ف ا غ ف ي ص ب ر | L8: ع ش ا ق ه و ك م غ ي ر ن | L9: ج ر م غ ث ي ن ا ش ر ق | L10: ا ش ر ق ا
contents.direction_remark: not stated; red Arabic letters sit above many signs (about 78 in all, not over every sign); signs are the same family as f. 57r-56v (arches, cups, boxes, triangles, 'm'-shapes) and appear in repeated groups; dotted dividers, about 4 groups per line; line 10 is short (about 6 signs); sign counts approximate; red letters read right to left (not every red letter is certain: tailless d/r/w shapes are ambiguous, written ر or د by best guess). Parts of the red string match the plaintext verse given on lines 12-13: L4 reds read 'على وجه ... ما الجمال' (alif-lam-jim-m), L5 'ال مرقرق يزيد اذا', L6 'رددت طرفك رنقا' - so the red letters are the plaintext letters over the signs (partial: some letters omitted, e.g. the waw of rawnaq). L7-L10 reds do not match the visible plaintext and presumably gloss a second verse not given on this page

contents.text: فحله سريعا وارسله ولاحظ ان يكون حققت عوض رددت [doubtful: 'ولاحظ' and 'حققت'; the end of line 11 is damaged/unclear]

على وجهه ماء الجمال مرقرق يزيد اذا رددت / طرفك رونقا [verse: 'on his face is the flowing water of beauty, which increases if you turn your glance back, in radiance'; line 12 words 'مرقرق' and 'رددت' read with the red gloss, others from the black text; single hemistich/verse only]

technique_remarks: في الفاء ... وما احسن جناس قوله - 'on the fa ... how good is the paronomasia (jinas) of his words'; فهو سهل والا فهو سهو - 'it is easy, otherwise it is a slip (sahw)'; ولاحظ ان يكون حققت عوض رددت - 'and he noticed that [it should be] ... instead of ...' (reading doubtful; refers to a sign/letter mixup in the plaintext). Red gloss letters appear over the signs (partly on this page): they spell the plaintext of the verse on lines 12-13
plaintext_for: block on this page (lines 4-10): plaintext verse given on lines 12-13 (matches the red letters of lines 4-6); the red letters on lines 7-10 correspond to a further verse not seen here (check f. 58r). Lines 1-3 follow from the block on f. 57r (cipher_without_plaintext there: not answered by lines 1-3)
certainty: medium-high for the layout and the red letters of lines 4-6, medium for lines 7-10 (some red marks ambiguous), medium-low for words in lines 1-3 and 11; red letters are tiny, copied right to left in the order of the signs they stand above

contents.text: تبدي فاخفى صبر عشاقه وكم عيون بدت مع حين اشرق / اشرقا [line 1: last word 'اشرف' as written, probably 'اشرق'; line 2 is a short tail 'اشر ... قا' with a gap, i.e. 'ashraqa'; second verse(s) of the block on f. 57v]

وكنت نظمتهما حين غرب اشرقا وهو ايهام معنى لما فيه من ايهام / المطابقة مع مطابقة تبدي فاخفى في الصدر وهذا في العجز / فان الايهام احسن انواع التورية وايضا فبكا ومم عند تغريبه / اولى من عندا شرافه وانما غيرته هنا ليحصل فيه جناس / يصعب حله وما صعب الله تعالى على المشار اليه شي في / الحل ثم كتبت له بيتين قد من الاول منهما ركبت صدره / على عجز ثانيه وابتعته الثالث وكان فيهما من اداة التعريف / وهك ترجمتهما [lines 5-7 contain doubtful words: 'فبكا ومم', 'عندا شرافه', 'شي']

contents.direction_remark: not stated; a new alphabet of more ornate signs (scissor-like lam-alif-shaped sign recurring at the start of lines, boxes, arrow-triangles, T-shapes, 'm' arches, a long rectangle on the last sign); dotted dividers, about 3-4 groups per line; line 13 ends with a long box; counts approximate

technique_remarks: ايهام ... التورية - 'iham (double meaning) the best kind of tawriya'; وانما غيرته هنا ليحصل فيه جناس يصعب حله - 'I changed it here so that paronomasia results in it, making its solution hard'; ثم كتبت له بيتين قد من الاول منهما ركبت صدره على عجز ثانيه - 'then I wrote him two verses in which I set the first hemistich of the first on the second hemistich of the second' (cross-composed verses); وابتعته الثالث وكان فيهما من اداة التعريف - 'and I followed it with the third ... there was in them the definite article'; وما صعب الله على المشار اليه شيء في الحل - 'God made nothing hard for the addressee in the solution'; وهك ترجمتهما - 'and this is their interpretation (translation)' - the block follows
plaintext_for: lines 1-2 are the plaintext (second verse) answering the block on f. 57v (red letters L9-10 'ash-r-q' / 'ashraqa' match); lines 3-10 are commentary on those verses (iham, tatbiq); the block on lines 11-13 is introduced by 'wa-hak tarjamatuhuma' and is answered on f. 58v (not seen yet)
certainty: medium-high for layout and sign shapes, medium-low for the commentary words (lines 3-9 are in a smaller, crowded hand); ink stains and a dark mark right of cipher line 12

contents.direction_remark: continuation of the block begun at f. 58r lines 11-13 (so about 112 signs in 6 lines); same ornate alphabet (scissor/lam-alif-like sign, tall box, long rectangle, arrow-triangle, m-arches); dotted dividers, 4-5 groups per line; counts approximate

contents.text: فحلهما وارسلهما من ذاك البر بالاهرام من الاوطان / السعيد وكتب سمى بالبل مثلما غلطت وترجمته وهو ما خفى / عليه ولكنه ما اراد تفريعا من حسن ادبه ولطفه / ففهمت ذلك ومما [line 4 'من ذاك البر بالاهرام من الاوطان' and line 5 'سمى بالبل' doubtful]

مولى سما جدوده ونجوده كالليث في وثباته وثباته / ذو راحة ولفظ ندى وكف ردى فقضت بهلك عداته وعداته / [prose on lines 10-11 explains the verses:] وعجز البيت الاول فالمجد من وصفاته وصفاته وصدر الثاني / كالبحر في ارواءه ورواية ومكان الكاف في كالليث وو [verse text lines 8-9 doubtful in several words (e.g. 'جدوده', 'ثباته'); lines 10-11 are the compiler's analysis of how the two verses were composed (hemistichs swapped)]
ثم كتبت لسيدنا الشيخ الفاضل شهاب الدين احمد المترجم / بيتين لنجم الدين القزويني صاحب الحاوي رحمه الله فاراها [end of line 13 'فاراها' doubtful; continues on f. 59r (catchword)]
الصغير [?] - written in the right margin level with line 13, apparently glossing 'sahib al-Hawi' as al-Hawi al-Saghir; reading doubtful
المخدوم [?] - catchword at the bottom left corner, written diagonally, reading doubtful

correspondents.arabic: الشيخ الفاضل شهاب الدين احمد المترجم
correspondents.translit: al-Shaykh al-Fadil Shihab al-Din Ahmad al-Mutarjim (the 'translator/interpreter'; last word doubtful)
correspondents.note: addressee of the next cipher verses ('wa-katabtu li-sayyidina ...'); the verses are by Najm al-Din al-Qazwini, author of al-Hawi (al-Saghir per the marginal note)

correspondents.translit: Najm al-Din al-Qazwini, author of al-Hawi
correspondents.note: poet of the two verses cited at line 13, not a 'wa-kataba li' correspondent; reading 'al-Qazwini' not fully certain ('لقزويني')

technique_remarks: ركبت صدره على عجز ثانيه (f. 58r) continued: وعجز البيت الاول ... وصدر الثاني - 'the second hemistich of the first verse ... the first hemistich of the second' (hemistichs of two verses recombined); ومكان الكاف في كالليث - 'and the place of the kaf in ka-l-layth' (letter-placement remark on the verse); وترجمته - 'its interpretation'; the sentence 'مثلما غلطت' - 'just as I erred'
plaintext_for: lines 1-3 continue the block of f. 58r lines 11-13 ('hak tarjamatuhuma'); the two verses on lines 8-9 are presumably the plaintext (hemistich analysis on lines 10-11 refers to them); the new block announced by line 13 ('two verses for Najm al-Din al-Qazwini') continues on f. 59r
certainty: medium for layout; low-medium for the Arabic words in lines 4-11 (small crowded hand); worm hole at left margin by line 1; marginal note and catchword low

contents.text: المخدوم المشار اليه ومما [begins with the catchword 'al-makhdum' of f. 58v; continues 'fa-arahā ... al-makhdum al-mushar ilayhi' = 'he showed them to ... the aforementioned master']

contents.direction_remark: not stated; a simple small alphabet of cups (sin-like), hooks, thin triangles, small circles with dots; lines 2 and 6 both start (at the right) with the same 2-sign group (waw-like hook + ha-like curve); 3-5 groups per line, dotted dividers; short last line; counts approximate

contents.text: فحلهما وجهزهما ومما [word 2 'وجهزهما' doubtful]
كم حرقة لي في الحشا من ولد لي قد نشا / كنشاء رشده فما انشا كما نشا [two verses with rhyme -asha; second verse doubtful in the first half ('كنشاء رشده فما انشا'), the rhyme word 'nasha' repeated]

ثم كتب تحتهما خطه السعيد ما هندي الحلال الجيد ان / هذا الابعد نعب ولايكاد يخطر للانسان ان البيت / الاول سطرين والثاني سطر واحد وكله يا سيدنا / وهذا الذكاء الكثير مما يلبس على الذهن وبالله المستعان [line 10 'ما هندي الحلال الجيد' doubtful; line 13 is partly read]

correspondents.note: refers back to Shihab al-Din Ahmad on f. 58v line 12; no new name

technique_remarks: ان البيت الاول سطرين والثاني سطر واحد - 'that the first verse is two lines (sutur) and the second is one line' (the layout/division of the verses in the cipher is the trick; hard to guess); ولايكاد يخطر للانسان - 'it hardly occurs to a person'; وهذا الذكاء الكثير مما يلبس على الذهن - 'this great cleverness is something that confuses the mind'; the compiler's own comment is 'wa-kulluhu ya sayyidana' ('all of it, O our master')
plaintext_for: block on this page (lines 2-6): plaintext verses on lines 8-9 (after 'fa-halalahuma wa-jahhazahuma'); the block belongs to the pair of verses for Najm al-Din / Shihab al-Din announced on f. 58v lines 12-13 (the cipher block itself begins on this page; no earlier part seen)
certainty: medium for layout, medium-low for words on lines 8-13; dark ink stain at right margin line 1-2; sign counts approximate

contents.text: ولعمري لقد صدق وصدق فمن ابن حل الحلال / هذا مع هذا الجناس العظيم والغرابه والحروف الكثيره / فيه مما عادتها ان تكون فللله في الكلام وما احسن وارف / هذه العبارة واللطافه فالله تعالى حفظ عليه ما وهبه / وايم عليه نعمه منه وكرمه ثم كتبت له عظم الله شانه / بيتا للارتجال طردا وعكسا وهو [words doubtful: line 1 'فمن ابن حل الحلال', line 3 'مما عادتها', 'وارف', line 6 'بفرا طردا']

contents.gloss_letters: L7 (right to left, approx): م و د ت ه د و م ل ك ل ه و ل | L8 (right to left, approx): و ه ل ك ل م و د ت ه ت د د م  [line 8 looks like line 7 in reverse order (see remark); red letters are tiny, several uncertain, esp. the tailless د/ر/و shapes]
contents.direction_remark: the compiler says the verse is composed 'tardan wa-'aksan' (forwards and in reverse, i.e. a palindromic verse, line 6; line 11 says 'each two words of it has its letters reversed in the other'); the second line is the first line's sign sequence in reverse order (visible: line 7 ends on the left with sin-like + hook signs, line 8 starts on the right with the same signs); same sign alphabet as f. 59r (cups, hooks, triangles/arrows, small 'ha' circle, '8'-shaped sign); about 5 groups per line; counts approximate

contents.text: فابطا فيه ايام لصعوبته ثم حله وكتبه وارسله ومعه / اعتذار لتاخير [?] هذا البيت عبارة عن اربع كلمات / كل كلمتين منها حرفها معكوسة في الاخرى فكيف / يحل وهي في الحقيقة كلمتان والله لقد صدق فانه / مبني من سبعة احرف وهو [words 'لتاخير' and 'حرفها' doubtful; line 13 ends 'wa-huwa' (also the catchword)]
وهو [?] - catchword at the bottom left, written diagonally, reading doubtful

technique_remarks: بيتا للارتجال طردا وعكسا - 'a verse for improvisation, forwards and in reverse' (palindrome/reversible verse); هذا البيت عبارة عن اربع كلمات كل كلمتين منها حرفها معكوسة في الاخرى فكيف يحل وهي في الحقيقة كلمتان - 'this verse consists of four words, each two of which have their letters reversed in the other, so how can it be solved when in reality they are two words'; مبني من سبعة احرف - 'built from seven letters'; ثم حله وكتبه وارسله ومعه اعتذار لتاخير - 'then he solved it, wrote it and sent it with an apology for the delay' (it took him days because of its difficulty); also praise: الجناس العظيم والغرابه والحروف الكثيره (great jinas, strangeness, many letters)
plaintext_for: lines 1-5 close the exchange begun on f. 59r (the verse of the previous block, praised as 'sadaqa' etc.); the block on this page (lines 7-8) is a palindromic verse whose solution (a verse built from seven letters, read both ways) is NOT given as plaintext here; line 13 'wa-huwa' leads to a plaintext on f. 60r
certainty: medium for layout and the text of lines 9-13, low-medium for lines 1-6; red letters low-medium (tiny, partly ambiguous); worm hole at left margin lines 11-13

contents.text: مودته تدوم لكل هول وهل كل مودته تدوم [the palindromic verse for the block on f. 59v; the line ends with a few detached letters 'و م' / 'ويكه' at the left that are doubtful; the verse's letters mirror the red gloss letters on f. 59v line 7 (م و د ت ه د و م ل ك ل ه و ل)]

واحضر لي المولى كمال الدين ابن القاضي جمال الدين ابن / الشهاب محمود مترجما ترجمته هو برسوم المشار اليه / عظم الله شانه صورته [read as 'he brought me, the master Kamal al-Din ... a (cipher) in interpreted form, its interpretation by the signs/forms of the aforementioned (grandfather), may God exalt his rank - its form']

contents.direction_remark: not stated; new alphabet of crescent/hook signs, 'tah'-like ط shapes, 'ain-like loops, arrow-heads (line 8) and 'm/ayn'-like cursive signs; lines 9 and 10 look like mirror images of one another (and 5/6 may be too: same sign set in reverse order), suggesting another reversible (taradan wa-'aksan) verse; about 4-5 groups per line, dotted dividers; counts approximate

contents.text: فحللته وارسلته للمولى كمال الدين وهو
آه واشوقا لمن قد بدلوا صفو عيشي بعدهم بالكدر / كلما اشتقت تمنيتهم ضاع عمري في المنى واعمري [two verses; line 12 'قد بدلوا' and line 13 'تمنيتهم' read with doubt]

correspondents.arabic: المولى كمال الدين ابن القاضي جمال الدين ابن الشهاب محمود
correspondents.translit: al-Mawla Kamal al-Din ibn al-Qadi Jamal al-Din ibn al-Shihab Mahmud
correspondents.note: brings (and receives) the cipher; his grandfather 'al-Shihab Mahmud' is 'al-mushar ilayhi'; the block on lines 5-10 is solved and sent back 'li-l-mawla Kamal al-Din' (line 11); name read from lines 2-3 and 11, moderately secure

technique_remarks: line 1 supplies the palindromic verse for the previous page's block (مودته تدوم لكل هول وهل كل مودته تدوم), confirming the 'taradan wa-'aksan' technique stated on f. 59v; line 3 'مترجما ترجمته' - 'in interpreted form, its interpretation' (the compiler calls the plaintext rendering 'tarjama'); no technique statement for the new block
plaintext_for: line 1 = plaintext for the block on f. 59v lines 7-8; the new block on lines 5-10 is followed by 'fa-halaltuhu wa-arsaltuhu li-l-mawla Kamal al-Din wa-huwa' (line 11) and the plaintext on lines 12-13 (two verses, 'ah wa-ashawqa li-man qad baddalu ...')
certainty: medium for layout and sign counts, medium for lines 2-4 and 11-13, low-medium for individual words; worm hole at right edge line 12, dark blotch top-left

contents.text: وكتبت تحته بيتين دوبيت قديمين مشهورين [reading: 'two old famous dobayt (rubai-type) verses'; 'دوبيت' fairly clear]

contents.direction_remark: not stated; angular alphabet (boxes, cups, 'U=' pair recurring in nearly every line, T/cross shapes, triangles, small hooks); the sequence of a cup plus double-bar sign ('U=') recurs many times (lines 2, 3, 4, 6, 8), perhaps a frequent letter pair; dotted dividers, about 3-4 groups per line, last line very short (about 7 signs); counts approximate

contents.text: فوصلت اليه فلم يقدر على حلها فعرضتها على المخدوم المشار اليه / اسبغ الله ظلاله فحلهما ومما

ان كنت تريدنا فدع لذاتك لا لخطر غير ذكرنا في ذاتك / ضيعت بطول هجرنا او فاتك كم فاتك من وصالنا كم فاتك [two lines of a dobayt-type verse; doubtful in line 11 ('لا لخطر', 'ذكرنا') and in the last words of line 12]
ثم استدعى المخدوم ان اكتب شيئا عقدا يعسر حله يتمحن نفسه [reading: 'then the master asked me to write something knotted/encoded, hard to solve, to test himself']
الكلام [?] - catchword at the bottom left, written diagonally, reading doubtful

correspondents.arabic: المخدوم المشار اليه اسبغ الله ظلاله
correspondents.translit: al-makhdum al-mushar ilayhi, asbagha Allah zilalahu (the aforementioned master, may God extend his shade)
correspondents.note: the master (probably Kamal al-Din from f. 60r) solved a cipher the compiler's first addressee could not solve (lines 9-10), and (line 13) asks the compiler to write a hard cipher to test himself; no new name on this page

technique_remarks: فوصلت اليه فلم يقدر على حلها - 'I sent it to him and he was unable to solve it'; فعرضتها على المخدوم ... فحلهما - 'I showed it to the master ... and he solved them'; دوبيت - 'dobayt' verses (the plaintext form: two verses of a Persian-type quatrain form); ان اكتب شيئا عقدا يعسر حله - 'write something encoded that is hard to solve' (the master wants a test cipher)
plaintext_for: block on this page (lines 2-8): plaintext on lines 11-12 (after 'fa-halalahuma wa-mimma', line 10); line 1 introduces the block: 'I wrote under it two old well-known dobayt verses' (the block itself is these two verses); line 13 introduces a new cipher to be written on f. 61r (not seen); the block on f. 60r lines 5-10 had plaintext on f. 60r lines 12-13
certainty: medium for layout, sign counts approximate; medium for lines 1, 9-10, 13; low-medium for words of the verses in lines 11-12; worm hole at left margin line 12-13
